info.title: MagiBooking Cloud Developer API
info.description: Reviewed against the 2026-10-28 private cloud OAuth/MCP staging candidate. Preview operations are not deployed to production. Merchant-created direct bearer credentials; OAuth authorization-code with mandatory S256 PKCE is a separate staging preview; production remains direct bearer only. Every call checks current merchant/location authorization, subscription and quota. Catalog is merchant-shared, at most 100 items without pagination. Catalog writes require explicit merchant-wide opt-in; payment policy fields additionally require merchant:payment-rules:write. All write bodies are limited to 16384 bytes. No arbitrary email/SMS sending or agent-declared payment success.

servers.description: Production: use only operations marked production; base appointment creation is available but paid preview is not.

scopes.merchant:payment-rules:write: Edit shared merchant deposit and payment rules (separate explicit consent)

post.summary: Appointment created through the shared appointment creation service
post.description: Verify HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + '.' + exact request bytes using the endpoint signing secret. Header signature format v1=<hex>; reject timestamps outside five minutes. Retry payload bytes and event/delivery IDs remain stable; request timestamps are refreshed.

200.description: Durably received; duplicate event IDs must also be safely acknowledged.

default.description: Non-2xx, network errors and timeouts are retried up to 8 attempts. Redirects are never followed.
